data.one_liner: Extensions for DateTime and Duration to easily add, convert, and work with time in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Adds comprehensive extension methods to DateTime and Duration for cleaner date math, rounding, boundaries, and conversions. It provides calendar-aware arithmetic for months and years, precise duration parsing from numbers, and comparisons down to the microsecond level.
use_when: You need to perform calendar-aware date arithmetic like adding months or years to a DateTime
You want to convert and decompose Durations into specific units easily
You want cleaner syntax for creating Durations using integers or doubles (e.g. 1.days)
avoid_when: You need complex timezone management or localization formatting (use intl instead)
strengths: Extensive coverage with over 100 extensions and hundreds of tests
Calendar-aware handling of leap years and month/year boundaries
weaknesses: Relies entirely on standard Dart DateTime and Duration classes without a dedicated timezone engine
